name: Oshiete! Bloomer Sensei
source:
The protagonist is a licensed teacher who will take the job in a girls' school as a physical education teacher, thanks to an acquaintance of his.

The condition for him to be accepted as a teacher is to teach four girls that are troubled children, and rehabilitate them. 

The hero all of a sudden becomes...enthusiastic. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=263285]Getchu[/url]]
